chunks: Yet these are the people for whom there is nothing but Fire in the world to come. Fruitless will be what they have fashioned, and whatever they have done will perish.

key_terms.الْآخِرَةِ: The Hereafter / the world to come

ai.seo_question: What is the fate of those whose deeds are fruitless in the Hereafter according to Surah Hud?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the concept of 'habitat al-'amal' (nullification of deeds), illustrating that worldly actions devoid of true faith and divine alignment are ultimately futile in the Hereafter. It serves as a warning against the illusion of self-sufficient merit, emphasizing that only deeds rooted in Tawhid and guided by the Ahl al-Bayt's teachings hold eternal value.
